name: Paragraphs Bootstrap Carousel
description: Field formatter that renders a paragraphs reference field as a Bootstrap 5 carousel.
project_description:
Paragraph Bootstrap Carousel module provides a easy way to create bootstrap carousels with paragraphs

 After installation it will add a new Bootstrap carousel in the paragraphs type. You can use it to create a new field paragraph.

- in the display manage, select option Paragraph Bootstrap Carousel.

- mapping field. Field image is required

- if you don't select Field caption, it will generate paragraphs with display mode

- if you want render image origin you can set Image style = Original Image. Now you can define field image formater Image / Responsive image / url image

- Use with Responsive Image (you can define breakpoint image in paragraphs) Module for Mobile Carousels

 Version 8.x-1.1 support bootstrap 4 

 Version 2.x.x support bootstrap 5 carousel 

I tried to mix the two versions but it doesn't work well so I think it's better with 2 separate versions, version 2 support bootstrap 5 , but it supports also bootstrap 4 but you should fix 2 buttons left right with your own css

 Best support for Bootstrap 5 admin theme
